summary: The CRT split re-implements the congruence-kernel subgroup API (kernel normality, product of normal subgroups, transvection closure) by hand, and the two diagonal-conjugation lemmas re-prove Shimura 3.10's conjugation step already available in GLn/Basic.lean. Several smaller restatements of Mathlib and of existing TauCeti lemmas, plus two in-diff clone pairs.
